message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules** | Item | Description | |------|-------------| | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue). Each color has numbers 0‑9 (two of each except one 0) and two of each action card: Skip, Reverse, Draw Two. Four Wild cards and four Wild Draw Four cards. | | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are earned by collecting the cards left in opponents’ hands when you finish a round. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining deck face down as the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face up to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately. | | **Gameplay** | • Play proceeds clockwise (unless a Reverse changes direction).
• On your turn, you may play one card that matches either the **color**, **number**, or **symbol** of the top discard card.
• If you cannot play, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – You choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – You choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color; otherwise, you risk being challenged.) | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you play your second‑to‑last card, shout “UNO!” If you forget and another player calls you out before the next player takes a turn, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards all their cards. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of the cards remaining in opponents’ hands: numbers = face value, action cards = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Winning the Game** | First player to reach the target score (usually 500) wins. | **Optional Variations** | Variation | Effect | |-----------|--------| | **Stacking** | Players may stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards on top of each other, forcing the next player to draw the cumulative total unless they can counter with the same type. | | **No Challenge** | Some groups allow Wild Draw Four to be played freely without challenge. | | **Custom Decks** | Use themed decks or add extra cards for house rules. | **Key Tips** 1. Keep track of the current color and number to anticipate opponents’ moves. 2. Use action cards strategically—especially Reverse and Skip—to disrupt opponents. 3. Remember to call “UNO” on time to avoid penalties. Enjoy playing Uno!
